The '''Rattataki''' were a [[Near-Human]] species characterized by their chalk-white skin and bald heads. Virtually isolated from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Rattataki developed a violent society on their home planet of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], which involved extensive [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat. Warrior [[Aidus]] and criminal [[Kaliyo Djannis]] were both Rattataki. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] named [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was generally thought to be a Rattataki, while in fact she was a similar [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]-[[Human/Legends|Human]] hybrid species called [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirians]].

==History==
[[File:Aidus.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Rattataki warrior [[Aidus]]]]
The Rattataki were commonly thought to be descendants of a long-lost [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] expedition. While most other inhabitants of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] came from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], there were a significant number of off-worlder mercenaries who would come to Rattatak from time to time, likely to view or participate in gladiatorial combat, only to be stranded there permanently. The remarkably harsh conditions on the planet nearly drove its population to extinction.<ref name="TEA" /> For eons, the Rattataki constantly battled amongst themselves, the surface beasts and their fellow inhabitants (represented primarily by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]],<ref name="Ins122">{{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref>. [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteens]],<ref name="Ins122" /> [[Vollick/Legends|Vollick]],<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>) over the planet's limited resources. Despite being nearly completely isolated from [[The galaxy/Legends|the outside galaxy]], the Rattataki displayed remarkable initiative and continually created new ways to kill each other.<ref name="HaF">[[Republic 60|''Republic'' 60]]</ref><ref name="TEA" />

The Rattataki tribes were briefly unified under the warlord [[Rattatak(Warlord)|Rattatak]] who managed to bring the infighting tribes together to push back the beasts that infested the surface. Having previously lived in sprawling cave systems, the efforts of the warlord managed to secure several areas on the surface for the planet's populace. Strong fortresses were built across the mountains of the world and are a remnant of the time when the planet's tribes were unified, though Rattatak himself was lost in the struggle for the surface and the tribes resumed their old ways of infighting. This development allowed the species to make contact with societies outside of their homeworld, and travel offworld to settle on new planets.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Holonet: Humanoids">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|rattataki|Rattataki}}</ref>

Shortly afterwards the [[Great Galactic War]] broke out, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vich]], upon noting the relatively-unknown Rattataki's considerable combat prowess and affinity for battle, captured hundreds of tribes of native Rattataki to forge them into his own personal army. Vich soon recognized that a number of these Rattataki showed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity to the Force]], and seeing the potential in this, trained many of these as [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] who would answer to him personally. Unsurprisingly, the Rattataki's natural abilities in battle were quickly manifest, and Vich's Army became a force to be reckoned with. This new-found power caused Darth Vich, who was eager for more sway in the Empire, to grow increasingly ambitious. This ultimately resulted in a failed power-grab known as [[Darth Vich's insurrection]], after which most of his Rattataki forces were [[Death/Legends|killed]] outright or [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. However, rumors persisted during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|post war period]] that a small number of Vich's acolytes had defected during the failed insurrection, later being taken in by the Sith for [[Sith training|full training]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Holonet: Humanoids">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|rattataki|Rattataki}}</ref>

When many Rattataki warlords including the Siniteen leader [[Hal'Sted/Legends|Hal'Sted]] had gathered an army in the southern hemisphere to challenge [[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]], a powerful Vollick warlord had them killed so they could never be a threat to him. Only one child, who was looked after by Hal'Sted, named [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], escaped.<ref name="HaF" /><ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Nightsisters" />

Rattataki had no major contact with the Republic until a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec]], crash-landed. The Jedi soon found the young [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] Ventress, who had been living among the Rattataki, discovering her incredible potential to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="HaF" /><ref name="Nightsisters" /> Together, they united armies and brought peace to the planet,<ref name="HaF" /> until Kirske and some other warlords of the planet united to slay them, leading to the death of Narec, and causing Ventress to capture or kill their foes in a rage.<ref name="HaF" /><ref name="Nightsisters" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rattataki-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|224px|A Rattataki in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'']]
Rattataki is a playable species for players who choose the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]], [[Imperial Agent]] and [[Sith Inquisitor]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
Asajj Ventress was formerly a Rattataki preceding a retcon in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] that altered her birthplace to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and her species to [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]. [[Leland Chee]] speculated that she shaved her head to better blend in on her adopted homeworld.
